name: Sharp Energy
notes: Researched from public sharpenergy.com pages (Payment Options, Payment Assistance Program) and the public myaccount.sharpenergy.com Customer Login page only; no sign-in, no sign-up, no payment started. The login form labels the field Username but its placeholder asks for an Email, so the identifier is email with the Username label; links are Sign Up, Forgot Password? and Make a Payment (one-time payment without signing in). No MFA is described. AutoPay (Automatic Direct Debit) drafts checking/savings or a Visa/MasterCard/Discover card on the 5th, 10th or 15th of the month (customer picks). Stopping AutoPay is not documented (inferred). Credit cards carry a surcharge (amount not published, so not modelled); debit cards do not. Florida Public Utilities propane customers were renamed to Sharp Energy and keep their logins. No budget billing, late fee or online close-account path is published, so those are not claimed. Chesapeake SHARING grants up to $200 per calendar year for eligible customers. Independent review 2026-10-09: payment options, assistance and login pages re-checked (Username label with Email placeholder, Sign Up, Forgot Password?, Make a Payment, FPU notice, 5th/10th/15th drafts, 3 p.m./2 p.m. cutoffs, P.O. Box 829981, Western Union, SHARING up to $200). Sharp's contact page lists 888-742-7740 only for leaks, odors and emergencies; it is kept as the pay-by-phone number (the catalog also lists it for customer service and the IVR) with that caveat in the note. Review 2026-10-09 (2): the inferred autopay_cancel note was removed from the capability because supported-capability notes render on the AutoPay page as if the biller said them; the inference is recorded here instead.

sources.title: Sharp Energy Online Customer Portal - Customer Login

pay_by_phone.note: One-time payments can be made by phone through the automated system or with a representative.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: The Online Customer Portal is free and open around the clock for paying bills, enrolling in AutoPay and going paperless. First-time users register their propane account with Sign Up. Make a Payment on the login page takes a one-time payment without signing in.

You can also pay through the automated phone system with a credit card, debit card or checking account, mail a check payable to Sharp Energy to P.O. Box 829981, Philadelphia, PA 19182-9981, or pay cash at a participating Western Union agent (Western Union charges its own fee).
Credit card payments carry a surcharge; debit cards do not. Portal payments made after 3 p.m. and one-time card payments made after 2 p.m. post the next business day.

help.title: Automatic Direct Debit
paragraphs: AutoPay drafts your checking or savings account, or charges a Visa, MasterCard or Discover card, on the draft date you choose: the 5th, 10th or 15th of each month. Enroll in the Online Customer Portal.
steps: Log in to the Online Customer Portal.
Choose a bank account or card.
Pick the 5th, 10th or 15th as your draft date and confirm.

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: Turn on paperless billing in the Online Customer Portal to view your statements and invoices electronically instead of by mail.

help.title: Payment assistance
paragraphs: The Chesapeake SHARING Program gives elderly, disabled or fixed-income customers a grant of up to $200 per calendar year toward their gas heating bill.

Income-eligible households can also apply for public energy assistance such as LIHEAP through local agencies in Delaware, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia, North Carolina and Florida; in Florida you can dial 211 for local help.

help.title: Former Florida Public Utilities propane customers
paragraphs: Florida Public Utilities propane operations now carry the Sharp Energy name. Your account, login details and local team stay the same, so sign in with your existing username and password.
